# Terraform Cloudflare Account

> Account bootstrap, members and groups, API tokens, notifications, Logpush, and secrets store.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare`. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = "terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare"
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [api-token](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/api-token): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/api-token`
- [dns-settings](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/dns-settings): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/dns-settings`
- [logpush](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/logpush): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/logpush`
- [member](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/member): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/member`
- [notification](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/notification): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/notification`
- [secrets-store](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/secrets-store): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/secrets-store`
- [sharing](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-account/tree/main/modules/sharing): `terraform-cf-modules/account/cloudflare//modules/sharing`
